text.en: The University has fifteen constituent colleges out of which eight colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Dhule, Kolhapur, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar Halgaon and Kashti; two agricultural engineering colleges at Rahuri and Kashti; two colleges for horticulture at Pune and Kashti and one each college of Agri. Business Management and Food Technology at Kashti. The University has the Post Graduate Institute at its central campus of Rahuri
text.mr: The University has fifteen constituent colleges out of which eight colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Dhule, Kolhapur, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar Halgaon and Kashti; two agricultural engineering colleges at Rahuri and Kashti; two colleges for horticulture at Pune and Kashti and one each college of Agri. Business Management and Food Technology at Kashti. The University has the Post Graduate Institute at its central campus of Rahuri

text.en: The University offers Master degree at Post Graduate Institute, Rahuri, College of Agriculture, Pune, Kolhapur and Dhule; and Dr. A. S. College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology  at Rahuri
text.mr: The University offers Master degree at Post Graduate Institute, Rahuri, College of Agriculture, Pune, Kolhapur and Dhule; and Dr. A. S. College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology  at Rahuri

text.en: Further, the Post Graduate Institute, Dr. A. S. College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology offers the Doctoral level programmes in agricultural science and engineering, respectively.
